meaning: Every recommendation disposition is tracked; scoped implementations are not certification or proof of every ambitious outcome. Human studies, comparative model/specialist benefit and deferred infrastructure remain explicitly pending.

recommendations.recommendation: Canonical project schema and compatibility contract
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Canonical v2 structural/semantic contract and valid-draft diagnostics; shared rich/invalid conformance fixtures.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Every supported command handles schema-valid fixtures without an unhandled structural error; missing command-specific prerequisites return typed diagnostics before mutation. Malformed envelopes fail safely, while a blank valid draft remains usable as an explicitly incomplete draft.

recommendations.recommendation: Lossless canonical browser editing
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Lossless supported canonical editing/export, immutable IDs, exact original recovery, explicit unsupported legacy/precision/budget errors.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: No-edit round trips preserve all supported fields and IDs; no silent loss for over-limit display fixtures; accepted requirements remain accepted.

recommendations.recommendation: Flat snapshots, restore and corrupt-state recovery
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Flat twenty-snapshot envelopes, restore as new revision, corrupt startup preservation, recovery export, session/purge controls; no silent JSON string truncation.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Snapshot size grows linearly for a fixed-size project; 20 supported revisions reopen/export/restore; malformed history leaves current state recoverable.

recommendations.recommendation: Filesystem containment and non-destructive initialization
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Regular bounded reads, descriptor-relative POSIX no-follow writes, non-destructive init, output containment and ownership. Tested on Linux; other-platform hostile race protection unverified.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Controlled symlink and pre-existing-history fixtures cannot change any unauthorized file; errors identify the path and leave prior state intact.

recommendations.recommendation: Transactional revisions and managed artifact publication
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Journaled local commit/recovery under cooperating-writer lock; committed handoff generation/pointer and recoverable legacy projections. No distributed or multi-file atomicity claim.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Injected failures preserve an authoritative committed generation/pointer and recoverable prepared state; restart completes or conflicts explicitly. Concurrent edits preserve independent drafts and conflict or serialize; obsolete managed ADRs are removed safely without deleting unrelated files.

recommendations.recommendation: Correct and symmetric artifact validation
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Symmetric OAS 3.0/3.1 basic validation, installed full OpenAPI/project-schema adapters, typed partial results, actual-version method records; renderer policy/failure reporting.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Valid specification fixtures pass correct gates; malformed/empty-response fixtures fail at the appropriate layer; no raw traceback replaces a result.

recommendations.recommendation: Contract-preserving handoff compiler
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Native/detailed HTTP contracts, all eight supported-profile verbs, collision failures, raw non-HTTP contract preservation, data/schema/task/ADR projections and exact coverage.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Every supported operation/schema/task is emitted or has an exact blocker; duplicate operations never silently win; input/project/API correspondence is checked.

recommendations.recommendation: Faithful diagram aliases and explicit topology
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Stable safe Mermaid aliases, Unicode labels, no topology inferred from association order, textual relationship view.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Hyphen/Unicode/collision fixtures retain every supported entity; permutations of unordered associations cannot reverse a flow.

recommendations.recommendation: Typed graph semantics and explainable impact closure
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Typed identities/edges and order-independent closure with connectivity witnesses and unreached/manual-review gaps; no semantic causality claim.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Order-independent results on cycles/multiple paths; every impact has a supported witness; unknown areas never become no-impact assertions.

recommendations.recommendation: Scanner selection, CI inclusion and honest coverage
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Exact .git filtering with .github included; relevant selection; separate entry/read/bytes/deadline budgets; reconciled omissions and unknown unseen totals.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: CI fixtures are included; 400 irrelevant files cannot silently consume useful extraction budget; all exclusions/truncations reconcile in counts.

recommendations.recommendation: Shared revisioned evidence envelope
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Versioned observation identity, content hashes, spans, capture time, adapter/scope/fingerprint and declared optional evidence records; no invented Git commit.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A cited observation resolves to the correct captured source version or is marked stale/unavailable; unknown source commit is never invented.

recommendations.recommendation: Untrusted-content, data-minimization and retention boundary
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Source text cannot confer authority; minimized/redacted default exports/snippets and explicit private backups/retention. Host connector authority remains conditional; redaction incomplete.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Synthetic secret/instruction fixtures cannot authorize actions and are withheld/redacted from ordinary exports; authorization decisions are enforced outside source text.

recommendations.recommendation: Hard resource bounds for external inputs and tools
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Bounded regular-file reads, enumeration, killable regex/parser/tool workers, deadlines/output limits and POSIX CPU/file caps. OS authority isolation is not fabricated.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Adversarial regex, FIFO and huge-tree fixtures terminate within configured limits with recoverable structured reports.

recommendations.recommendation: Measured model-quality program and deterministic constraints
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Capture/provenance accounting, direct length constraints, bounded fixture validation and semantic review instruments. Real comparative model quality and calibrated human annotations remain pending.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Known unsafe keyword-stuffed fixtures fail semantic review; length limits are counted directly; release claims cite actual captures and disclose sample/variance limits.

recommendations.recommendation: Explicit CI gate policies and exit semantics
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Explicit structural/full/report policies and evaluate threshold exits; failed or required incomplete gates do not pass.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: 0/1 eval checks can report exit0 in report mode but must fail a selected required gate; required skipped checks cannot appear green.

recommendations.recommendation: Per-artifact readiness and exact blockers
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Profile-scoped exact field blockers, waivers-with-reason and independent completeness/structure/correspondence/review/runtime/freshness dimensions.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A draft placeholder API cannot be labeled implementation-ready; every blocker points to a field/record and next validation action.

recommendations.recommendation: Capability preflight, dry runs and stable diagnostics
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Doctor/preflight, dry-run plans, typed operation errors, recovery and explicit host enforcement limits. No unavailable integration is reported as executed.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Unavailable connector/renderer returns a useful scoped result; malformed inputs retain current state; dry run shows affected files and missing capabilities.

recommendations.recommendation: One intent/depth/audience vocabulary
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Independent task intent, three depths and audience; compatibility data preserved and no mandatory dossier for quick answers.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Task×depth×audience fixtures route consistently; quick questions do not start a full interview or force persistent project state.

recommendations.recommendation: Safe requirement and ADR correction workflow
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Draft editing, accepted predecessor supersession, explicit deliberate accepted edits, reference-safe deletion, undo and no-op acceptance continuity.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Correction changes only intended fields; accepted predecessor remains reviewable; no silent dangling references after deletion. No-op resumption preserves acceptance without redundant reacceptance; unknown historical approvers remain unknown.

recommendations.recommendation: Accessible and bilingual authoring
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Labeled controls, selected navigation/focus/status, keyboard-native actions, textual graph and dir=auto Persian/English editing. Real browser/assistive-technology validation remains limited by host runtime.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Keyboard/zoom/narrow-view journeys complete; graph meaning is available as text; mixed Persian/English exports preserve labels and IDs.

recommendations.recommendation: Structured assumptions, risks and NFR verification scenarios
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Optional assumptions/risks/evidence/verifications/experiments with NFR scenario and actual-verification gap reporting; no mandatory paperwork for every note.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Important NFRs and decisions have source/assumption/verification or exact gap; no coverage metric implies semantic satisfaction.

recommendations.recommendation: Continuation packet and source freshness check
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Compact current revision/accepted choices/constraints/questions packet excluding private history/extensions; preserve unknown approval origin and unchanged acceptance.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A resumed fixture identifies correct revision/accepted choices, detects changed source identity and limits retrieval to decision-relevant evidence. No-op resumption preserves recorded acceptance without a fresh approval interview; packets omit irrelevant private history.

recommendations.recommendation: Reviewable architecture change bundles
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Reviewable baseline/proposal semantic delta, impacts and compatibility/data/security/NFR/applicable recovery obligations; explicit expected-hash commit, no automatic acceptance rewriting.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Each material change has rationale, source and owner when known, plus applicable validation and rollback/forward-fix requirements; trivial text edits need no operational rollout ceremony. No unrelated accepted decision changes silently.

recommendations.recommendation: Artifact staleness and decision revisit detection
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Evidence-content freshness and artifact-input hash staleness with source/generator/output manifests; unknown/unread stays distinct from deletion.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Changing a linked source invalidates the correct derived artifacts; unrelated stable artifacts remain reusable; unknown freshness remains explicit.

recommendations.recommendation: Narrow language/framework parser adapters
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Scoped Python AST imports/route candidates and JS/TS static module token adapter; comments/templates ignored, unresolved language/framework behavior explicitly unknown.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Fixtures include comments/strings/dynamic cases and supported frameworks; precision/coverage reported separately by adapter.

recommendations.recommendation: Deployment, data and event evidence extraction
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Selected package dependencies, compose services/depends_on, GitHub jobs/needs, OpenAPI paths and AsyncAPI channels. Generic IaC/runtime reconstruction is outside the declared adapter scope.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Every extracted edge cites supported syntax and source version; unsupported descriptors are explicitly listed.

recommendations.recommendation: Architecture fitness checks with counterexamples
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Supported forbid-import rule emits exact counterexamples and violation/satisfied-in-scope/unknown with source identity; no global compliance grade.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Known violating fixture yields evidence-linked counterexample; missing extractor evidence yields unknown rather than pass.

recommendations.recommendation: Architecture revision delta; later measured extraction cache
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Observed base/head evidence deltas and optional bounded local extraction cache keyed by path/content/adapter/source; no universal semantic index.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Incremental results agree with a clean supported-scope scan and disclose skipped/invalidated evidence.

recommendations.recommendation: Evidence-based modernization and migration packs
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Evidence-attributed modernization worksheet with modularization-first comparison, ownership/compatibility/reconciliation/canary/applicable recovery. Actual migration is not executed.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A migration fixture names data ownership and failure recovery, reversible stages and validation before the next stage.

recommendations.recommendation: Portable engineering-tool and task exports
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Portable accepted coding rules and task/AC exports, native contracts/diagrams/ADRs, source/readiness identity. No tracker/commit/comment write occurs automatically.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Exports retain IDs/source/readiness and reopen; no default commit/comment/task creation or silent cross-service data disclosure.

recommendations.recommendation: Local run telemetry and useful quality metrics
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Explicit minimized local run receipts with version/status/counts/duration and no raw prompts/source. Real outcome and cost study data remain unmeasured.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Run reports reconcile partial stages, contain no synthetic secret, and permit measuring actual task outcomes without mandatory remote analytics.

recommendations.recommendation: Finite, unit-safe and consistent capacity/scoring math
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Finite inputs/results/weights, strict JSON, raw intermediate math, decimal GB billing vs KiB/GiB units and CLI/JS conformance cases; UI inputs reflect imported state.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: CLI/browser conformance and boundary fixtures agree within declared precision; invalid calculations are withheld with field errors.

recommendations.recommendation: Discoverable outcome journeys and honest examples
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Three discoverable outcome journeys, blank default/deliberate samples, distinct portable/backup/brief names and truthful checks/statuses.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Users can identify next action/file purpose/readiness in scoped trials; blank projects do not masquerade as measured architecture.

recommendations.recommendation: Cross-surface release conformance and reproducible packaging
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Original and new negative/positive/cross-surface/fault/privacy/resource conformance, pinned optional validator environment and package preservation/readback verification.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Release bundle runs deterministic conformance checks; regression cases for reproduced defects cannot pass silently; skipped optional tools remain visible.

recommendations.recommendation: Selective specialist reviews with budget and independence
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Selective independent-first-pass/peer-review protocol and bounded review plan only; no agent dispatcher or comparative benefit study is fabricated.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Controlled comparison to a single-pass baseline measures useful corrected findings versus cost; no specialist bypasses tool authorization.

recommendations.recommendation: Decision experiments and scenario sensitivity
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Decision experiment/revisit instruments, bounded parameter sensitivity and proposed migration/measurement criteria; no cloud provisioning or invented thresholds.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A decision fixture states what evidence would change the choice and how to measure it; sensitivity results show assumptions and omissions.

recommendations.recommendation: Validate target users and engineering outcomes
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Research task protocol, observation template and decision gates. Actual participants/interviews/task outcomes are not available and were not invented.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Document observed needs, counterexamples and decision criteria for the next optional investments; no unsupported market ranking.

recommendations.recommendation: Hosted shared projects and native app surface
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Deferred as recommended: no hosted multi-user/native-app service created; separate demand, auth/storage/concurrency/operations gates documented.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Prototype must demonstrate tenant isolation, conflict recovery and user value; do not claim delivery until real service/host tests run.

recommendations.recommendation: Universal semantic repository index or graph database
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Deferred as recommended: local typed graph and selected adapters used; no universal vector/semantic index or graph database added.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: A benchmarked workload shows simpler approach insufficient and a prototype improves evidence retrieval within budgets before adoption.

recommendations.recommendation: Multi-model judges and autonomous expansion
recommendations.delivered_and_limits: Deferred as recommended: no multi-model/autonomous deployment service; controlled future experiment and deterministic authority gates documented.
recommendations.acceptance_from_report: Compare blinded judged cases and actual corrections/cost; unsupported outputs or majority agreement never become accepted facts.

follow_up.scope: Acceptance counterexamples in revision/recovery, local workbench and validation. No pending study or deferred service was reclassified as completed.
